lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Our company needs to master the wave of globalization.
lines.jp: 当社、グローバリゼーションの波を乗りこなせ

jpTokens.s: グローバリゼーション

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Understood. We're also exploring retirement fund management through investment trusts.
lines.jp: はい。退職金は投信での運用も検討します

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: We're launching a flagship store network with the scale and visibility of a carrier.
lines.jp: 当社、空母型の旗艦店を展開しろ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Understood. We'll coordinate our advertising push with the league playoff season.
lines.jp: はい。リーグのプレーオフ時期に合わせて広告を出します

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Update the background music rotation on our in-store broadcast system.
lines.jp: 有線放送のBGMを更新しろ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Understood. We'll accelerate the concrete work on the new facility.
lines.jp: はい。新工場のセメント工事を急ぎます

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Our business planning framework needs to be reconsidered from the ground up.
lines.jp: 当社、事業プランニングを再検討しろ

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Understood. We'll adapt our operations to align with the Ministry of Agriculture's new regulations.
lines.jp: はい。農水省の制度変更に対応します
